title: arequipa aurantiaca
intro: Arequipa aurantiaca, commonly known as the golden chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote a restful sleep. The therapeutic actions of Arequipa aurantiaca include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative properties, making it a popular natural remedy for insomnia and other sleep-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
